Agent Engineering Brief — 03
Technical judgment

People define the task and evaluate generated code
Domain knowledge helps expose missing assumptions
Vendor guidance does not establish measured benefits
Sources: GitHub skills guidance; Latent Space interview
Controls matched to risk

A prototype and a payment service need different checks
The field guide proposes a staged maturity model
Its checklist is guidance, not a universal minimum
Source: Stack Overflow production field guide
A concrete security cost

GitHub reports roughly 30% prevention before exposure
Its new classifier could expand prevention
The announced private preview consumes AI credits
Source: GitHub Secret Protection announcement; vendor claims
Deno and Cloudflare’s roadmap

The teams announced a plan to combine runtime work
Existing self-hosting differs from the promised integration
Delivery and small-team economics remain unverified
Source: Cloudflare announcement, October 9, 2026
Missing perspectives

No selected source measures student-team outcomes
Novice maintainers and accessibility needs lack coverage
Vendor incentives shape much of the available evidence
Limitations of this evidence set
One bounded task

Name the person responsible for checking the result
Match controls to the consequences of failure
Compare time saved with time spent finding defects
Editorial recommendation, not a measured productivity result
